data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC under pressure, ETH trades sideways, XRP gravitates toward $1 | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) remain under pressure on Friday after mild gains, while Ripple (XRP) slides over 5% so far this week. BTC faces rejection near a key resistance barrier, and ETH has been trading sideways for the last 22 days.
